new_promises.statement: Target 35 to 40 new Tanishq store openings for the full year.
new_promises.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
new_promises.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

new_promises.statement: Eyewear business is expected to close the year at 13% to 14% growth.
new_promises.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
new_promises.speaker: N. S. Raghavan
